findings.evidence: Plan structure: Overview, Prerequisites, Phases with tasks, Testing Strategy, Dependency Graph, Risks, Rollback ... Complexity 1-10, Test-First Approach and testable Acceptance Criteria.
findings.fix: Keep only the parts the model would not choose by default, namely task IDs in Dependencies so work can run in parallel, and Location limited to file paths. Point to a short template rather than restating a generic plan outline.

findings.evidence: Add `--skip-git-repo-check` only when `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` fails. ... State the directory the command must run from
findings.fix: Indent the code fences and follow-up paragraphs of steps 5 and 6 under their list items. As written, the numbered phase list breaks apart, and step 6's sub-instructions read like free-standing text outside the process.

findings.evidence: The command uses relative paths: run it from the directory holding `prompt_to_codex.md`, or `$(cat ...)` fails and the plan lands elsewhere.
findings.fix: This gotcha repeats step 6 (line 41: "State the directory the command must run from"). Replace it with one the body does not already cover, such as a very large prompt passed through `"$(cat ...)"` hitting the shell argument-length limit, and what to do instead.

findings.evidence: `diff` the two literal paths (or ask the user to). Flag any difference.
findings.fix: Make it a default with an escape hatch: "Run `diff <baseline> <second>` yourself. Ask the user only if Bash is unavailable." Also say what to do with a difference, for example list the changed paths and do not review the plan as clean.

findings.evidence: Outside git, or if the line prints the failure message, say change verification is unavailable. Without a HEAD (unborn repo) the diff part fails: say verification is limited to `git status`.
findings.fix: In an unborn repo, `git diff HEAD` fails, so the line prints "baseline failed: change verification unavailable". That matches both branches and tells the agent two different things. Check `git rev-parse --verify HEAD` first. Without a HEAD, run only `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall -- . ":(exclude)<plan file>" > "<literal path>"` and report that verification is limited to git status.
